description: A boat at anchor, for the anchoralarm plugin. Engines are off (the anchor profile). At 0 s the Hoeken plugin's anchor is cleared so only anchoralarm watches. At 2 s the anchor is dropped where the boat is, and at 3 s its limit is set to 45 m by PUT of maxRadius, as the radius buttons do. The boat swings 28-30 m out. From 40 s it drifts to about 52 m, past the limit, and the plugin raises the anchor alarm (the plugin does it, from the position; nothing is written to notifications). From 70 s it is back inside and the plugin clears it. The anchor is raised at 85 s. Needs anchoralarm enabled; set anchor.plugin to anchoralarm in the display config to drive it from the display. anchor-holding does the same for the Hoeken plugin.

after.note: only one plugin watches: clear the other's anchor (best effort)
clear any anchoralarm anchor left from before (best effort)
set the limit as the display's radius buttons do
drifts to about 52 m, past the 45 m limit: the plugin raises the alarm
back inside the limit: the plugin clears the alarm
